mind.workspace.cycle_s.cost: Nothing leaves this computer: no cloud AI ever gets Brain's read of you, its journal facts or its numbers.
mind.workspace.cycle_s.tip: The least gap in seconds between two cycles (events poke it sooner).
mind.workspace.cycle_s.when: Raise it to save a little work on a slow computer.

mind.workspace.on.cost: Nothing leaves this computer: no cloud AI ever gets Brain's read of you, its journal facts or its numbers.
mind.workspace.on.tip: A small "now" stage that parts compete to enter; only what wins may start a message or act on its own.
mind.workspace.on.when: Turn it off and nothing it decides by salience gates messages any more. `/thinking` shows it.

modules.enabled.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except downloads of the models and programs you ask it to install.
modules.enabled.tip: The features that are on. The Features page changes it.
modules.enabled.when: Use the Features page (or `kurooto enable`/`disable`), which sets each feature up properly; editing this list by hand skips that.

notes.layout.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes.layout.tip: How your notes folder is laid out: Kurooto's folders, or a Zettelkasten.
notes.layout.values: `kurooto` (journal/, about-me/, a folder per subject) or `zettelkasten` (dailies/, master/, sources/, zettel/).
notes.layout.when: Pick the one closest to how you already keep notes. The setup page's Notes step reads your folder and moves Kurooto's own notes to fit, with Undo.

notes.links.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes.links.tip: How Kurooto links notes: `[[wikilinks]]` or Markdown links.
notes.links.when: Pick `markdown` if you read your notes outside Obsidian (GitHub, a static site). Only new links change; old ones stay.

notes.open_with.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes.open_with.tip: The program that opens a note from the dashboard; empty uses the system's.
notes.open_with.values: A command, with `{path}` for the note: `kitty nvim {path}`.
notes.open_with.when: Set it to open notes in your own editor.

notes.paths.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes.paths.tip: Your own place for a kind of note, over the layout's.
notes.paths.when: When one kind of note should live somewhere else than the layout puts it. New notes of that kind go there.

notes_sync.after_jobs.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes_sync.after_jobs.tip: Minutes after an AI request finishes that the notes it wrote go up; 0 waits for the timer.
notes_sync.after_jobs.when: Set 0 to sync only on the timer.

notes_sync.api.tip: The Git host's API address. Leave it alone.
notes_sync.api.when: Only for GitHub Enterprise or tests.

notes_sync.branch.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes_sync.branch.tip: The branch your notes sync to (filled in from the repository).
notes_sync.branch.when: Only if you keep notes on another branch than the repository's default.

notes_sync.every.cost: Changed notes go up to GitHub each time.
notes_sync.every.when: Shorten it if you edit on several devices; lengthen it to sync less often.

notes_sync.on_conflict.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes_sync.on_conflict.tip: When a note changed in two places at once: keep both versions, or stop and wait for you.
notes_sync.on_conflict.values: `keep both` (this computer's copy goes next to it as a conflict note) or `stop` (sync stops, changes nothing, tells you once).
notes_sync.on_conflict.when: Pick `stop` if you'd rather sort out every clash yourself. Nothing is lost either way.

notes_sync.remote.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except with Notes sync (your notes go to your own private GitHub repository) and the sorter's short question to your AI.
notes_sync.remote.tip: For tests only: a local repository instead of GitHub.

notes_sync.repo.cost: Your whole notes folder is copied to that private repository on GitHub, and kept in step.
notes_sync.repo.tip: The private GitHub repository your notes sync to.
notes_sync.repo.when: Set during Notes sync's setup, with a token for just that repository.

notes_sync.share_with_calls.cost: Your call line reads notes from GitHub during a call, with the sync token.
notes_sync.share_with_calls.tip: Let your call line read notes from your repository during a call while this computer is off.
notes_sync.share_with_calls.when: Turn it off if calls shouldn't read your notes at all while the computer is away.

notify.app_chat.cost: Sealed with your phone's key through your call line.
notify.app_chat.tip: Kurooto's own messages also show in the phone app's chat, not just on Telegram.
notify.app_chat.what: Everything not already in `notify.app_kinds`: reminders, results, information.
notify.app_chat.when: Turn it on where Telegram is blocked or you'd rather use the app's chat.

notify.app_kinds.cost: Each one goes sealed with your phone's key through your call line, which can't read it.
notify.app_kinds.tip: Which kinds of message also reach your phone app.
notify.app_kinds.values: A list of kinds: `call`, `question`, `approval`, plus `reminder`, `deadline`, `result`, `info` if you want those.
notify.app_kinds.when: Add kinds you want on the phone too; remove `question` and `approval` to keep those on Telegram only.

notify.calm.calls.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.calls.tip: How many calls a day may come by themselves; one past it waits in the evening bundle as a call link.
notify.calm.calls.values: A whole number; 0: none by themselves.
notify.calm.calls.when: Raise it if you like being called for reminders and check-ins; set 0 to be called only when you asked. The alarm and calls you asked for never count.

notify.calm.evening.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.evening.tip: Kinds of message that always wait for the evening bundle.
notify.calm.evening.values: A list of message kinds, e.g. `["research", "weekly"]`; filled by Less of this → Another time.
notify.calm.evening.when: Usually set by tapping Less of this → Another time. Remove a kind to get it as it happens again.

notify.calm.evening_at.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.evening_at.tip: When the evening bundle comes with everything that waited today.
notify.calm.evening_at.when: Move it to when you usually look at your phone in the evening. After this time, messages come as they are.

notify.calm.fewer.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.fewer.tip: Kinds of message limited to a number a day; more wait for the evening.
notify.calm.fewer.values: A JSON object, kind → number: `{"quiz": 1}`; filled by Less of this → Fewer.
notify.calm.fewer.when: Usually set by tapping Less of this → Fewer. Raise or remove a kind's number to get more of it.

notify.calm.habituate.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.habituate.tip: After this many of a kind go unanswered in a row, they wait for the evening until you answer one.
notify.calm.habituate.values: A JSON object, kind → number; set by Dreaming, with Undo.
notify.calm.habituate.when: Dreaming fills it in from what you leave unanswered. Remove a kind to have it always come as it happens.

notify.calm.lighter_after.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.lighter_after.tip: After an exam or a heavy day, the next day's limit is halved.
notify.calm.lighter_after.when: Turn it off if you'd rather have the same flow every day.

notify.calm.messages.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.messages.tip: How many messages a day may come by themselves; the rest wait for the evening bundle.
notify.calm.messages.when: Raise it if useful things keep waiting until evening; lower it for a quieter day. The first time a day the limit holds one, a line says so with Send them as they come today / Raise to 12 / Fine.

notify.calm.monthly.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.monthly.tip: Once a month, it names a kind of question you hardly ever answer and offers to turn it off.
notify.calm.monthly.when: Turn it off if you don't want the monthly suggestion. Nothing is turned off without your tap either way.

notify.calm.on.cost: Nothing leaves. On, what was sent and why is recorded on this computer for 45 days.
notify.calm.on.tip: Calm: each message Kurooto sends by itself says why, has Why? and Less of this, and there's a daily limit.
notify.calm.on.when: Turn it off to have everything come as it happens, with no buttons and nothing recorded, exactly as before Calm existed.

notify.calm.stopped.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.stopped.needs: `notify.calm.on`. Used only for kinds whose feature has no switch of its own.
notify.calm.stopped.tip: Kinds of message you stopped with Less of this → Stop.
notify.calm.stopped.when: Remove a kind to start getting it again (or use Undo on the message that stopped it).

notify.calm.windows.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.calm.windows.tip: Hours a kind of message may come in; outside them it waits for the evening bundle.
notify.calm.windows.values: A JSON object, kind → `"10:00-18:00"`; set by Dreaming, with Undo.
notify.calm.windows.when: Dreaming sets it from when you actually answer; edit or remove a kind to change its hours.

notify.desktop.cost: Nothing leaves: the system's own notifications.
notify.desktop.when: Turn it off if you only want messages on your phone. A message that no other channel took still pops up.

notify.desktop_kinds.tip: Which kinds of message pop up on this computer.
notify.desktop_kinds.when: Add `reminder` if you sit at this computer all day; remove kinds that distract you.

notify.presence.after_min.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.presence.after_min.tip: How long Kurooto must be away before going offline or coming back is worth a message.
notify.presence.after_min.when: Raise it if short sleeps and network blips cause messages you don't need.

notify.presence.channels.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.presence.channels.tip: Where the offline and back-online messages go.
notify.presence.channels.values: A list of `telegram` and `app` (the phone app).
notify.presence.channels.when: Add `app` if you mostly use the phone app; remove `telegram` to keep them off your chat.

notify.presence.line.cost: Your call line (on your own Cloudflare account) watches the computer's link and sends the message itself.
notify.presence.line.tip: While this computer can't speak (asleep, crashed, offline), your call line tells you so.
notify.presence.line.when: Turn it off if you don't want messages from the call line while the computer is away.

notify.presence.line_telegram.cost: On, your bot's token is kept on your call line (your own Cloudflare account), so it can send to your chat.
notify.presence.line_telegram.tip: Whether your call line may keep your bot's token, so it can tell you on Telegram while the computer is away.
notify.presence.line_telegram.values: none (asked once), on, or off (off deletes the token there at the next sync, within 5 minutes).
notify.presence.line_telegram.when: Answer the question when it comes; change it later here. Off, the call line can only reach the phone app.

notify.presence.on.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
notify.presence.on.tip: Tell you when Kurooto goes offline, and again when it's back with what it caught up on.
notify.presence.on.what: A clean stop says so before it exits; coming back says how long it was away and what it caught up on. Never a call; at night it waits for the morning.
notify.presence.on.when: Turn it off if you don't care when the computer sleeps or restarts.

overlay.code.cost: Your own add-ons run as you and may reach whatever they're written to. Add-ons by link reach only the hosts on the card you agreed to.
overlay.code.tip: Also run the Python add-ons in its modules/ folder (off: only skills, prompts and settings).
overlay.code.when: Turn it off to use an add-ons folder's skills and settings without running its code.

overlay.path.cost: Your own add-ons run as you and may reach whatever they're written to. Add-ons by link reach only the hosts on the card you agreed to.
overlay.path.tip: The full path of your add-ons folder.
overlay.path.when: Point it at the folder with your modules, skills, prompts and settings.json. Read when Kurooto starts.

persona.avoid.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
persona.avoid.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.avoid.tip: Things answers should never have, such as emojis or motivational lines.
persona.avoid.values: A short list in your own words, e.g. "emojis, exclamation marks".
persona.avoid.when: When something in the AI's style keeps annoying you. The next answer and call leave it out.

persona.boundaries.cost: Nothing: rules on this computer. Off, those requests go to your AI like any other.
persona.boundaries.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.boundaries.tip: Health, relationship and money decisions stay yours: Kurooto names who to ask instead.
persona.boundaries.what: Every AI request and call is told so, and a request that asks Kurooto to make such a decision ("should I stop my meds") is answered at once, without the AI, with a short line naming a person to ask. It's a list of rules, not a judgement: anything else goes on as usual.
persona.boundaries.when: Leave it on. Turn it off only if the rule keeps catching ordinary questions; then such requests go to the AI like any other.

persona.call_me.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
persona.call_me.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.call_me.tip: What the AI calls you: a nickname, your first name, or nothing.
persona.call_me.values: Any text; empty uses your name, or nothing.
persona.call_me.what: The dashboard's About you page and `/persona` change it too.
persona.call_me.when: When the AI's way of addressing you feels off. The next answer and the next call use it.

persona.length.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
persona.length.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.length.tip: How long answers should be, in your own words.
persona.length.values: A short phrase, e.g. "short unless I ask for detail". Empty: by the length of your message (see `persona.register`).
persona.length.when: When answers keep coming out longer or shorter than you like. What you write here wins over the length-matching of `persona.register`.

persona.register.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
persona.register.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.register.tip: A short message gets a short answer, a voice note a spoken-style one.
persona.register.what: By the message's length only: nothing changes with the time of day or partway through a conversation.
persona.register.when: Turn it off if you want the same style of answer whatever you send. A length on your persona card wins over it either way.

persona.tone.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
persona.tone.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
persona.tone.tip: The tone you want answers in, in your own words.
persona.tone.values: A short phrase, e.g. "plain and direct, no pep talk". Empty: the AI's usual tone.
persona.tone.when: When answers feel too chirpy, too formal or too long-winded. It shapes wording from the next request; facts and actions don't change.

power.on_battery.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except downloads of the models and programs you ask it to install.
power.on_battery.tip: What Kurooto does on battery: put off heavy work, carry on as usual, or pause.
power.on_battery.values: `saver` (heavy work waits for the charger; Telegram and reminders keep working), `normal` (as if plugged in), `pause` (nothing runs until you plug in; the call line still rings the alarm).
power.on_battery.when: Pick `normal` on a laptop with a big battery; `pause` if you want it quiet whenever you're unplugged.

privacy.allow_hosts.tip: More hosts Kurooto may reach, besides its list and the addresses you set up yourself.
privacy.allow_hosts.values: A list of host names: `["feeds.example.org"]`; `.example.org` allows all of it.
privacy.allow_hosts.when: Add a host `/egress` shows as not on the list and that you trust, before turning on `enforce`.

privacy.egress.cost: Nothing: these settings decide what is kept and where requests may go; they send nothing themselves.
privacy.egress.tip: Count every request Kurooto makes on the internet, also refuse hosts not on the list, or neither.
privacy.egress.values: `record` (count everything; a host not on the list is counted and still reached), `enforce` (refuse such hosts, naming them and how to allow them), `off`.
privacy.egress.when: Look at `/egress` for a while on `record`, allow what you trust, then switch to `enforce`. Add-ons by link are fenced to their own hosts in every mode.

privacy.gist_days.cost: Nothing: these settings decide what is kept and where requests may go; they send nothing themselves.
privacy.gist_days.tip: Gists are deleted after this many days; 0 keeps them until you `/forget all`.
privacy.gist_days.when: Set it if even one-line gists shouldn't be kept for long.

privacy.gist_model.cost: Nothing: these settings decide what is kept and where requests may go; they send nothing themselves.
privacy.gist_model.tip: A model on this computer adds a sentence to a call's gist.
privacy.gist_model.when: Turn it on for richer call gists; it never uses a cloud AI.

privacy.keep_days.cost: Nothing: these settings decide what is kept and where requests may go; they send nothing themselves.
privacy.keep_days.tip: Transcripts, AI requests and answers, chats and logs are deleted after this many days; 0 keeps them.
privacy.keep_days.when: Set it (say, 30) if you don't want old conversations kept. Other features' own retention follows it where they say so.

privacy.keep_gist.cost: Nothing: these settings decide what is kept and where requests may go; they send nothing themselves.
privacy.keep_gist.tip: As a conversation's words fade, it settles into one line of what it decided (`/gists`).
privacy.keep_gist.when: Turn it off to keep nothing once the words are gone.

profile.after_changes.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
profile.after_changes.tip: Minutes after you change a setting (or turn a feature on or off) that the profile is saved.
profile.after_changes.when: Lower it to save sooner after changes.

profile.branch.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
profile.branch.tip: The branch your saved profile lives on (set by Kurooto).

profile.remote.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
profile.remote.tip: For tests only: a local repository instead of GitHub.

profile.repo.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
profile.repo.tip: Your private GitHub repository for Profile sync; empty uses the one Notes sync uses.
profile.repo.when: Set it to keep your profile apart from your notes' repository.

profile.when.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
profile.when.tip: When your profile is saved each day.
profile.when.when: Move it to when the computer is usually on.

projects.check_timeout_s.tip: Seconds a project check may run before it's stopped.
projects.check_timeout_s.when: Raise it for slow test suites.

projects.checks.cost: Runs on this computer, in the scratch copy.
projects.checks.tip: A command that checks a project (its tests, a LaTeX build), run after the AI's changes.
projects.checks.when: Set one so proposals come with a pass or fail. It runs in the scratch folder, with a time limit and no network.

projects.effort.cost: Paper searches go to arXiv, bioRxiv, PubMed and your feeds; ranking, project help and minutes go to your AI. Repositories are read on this computer.
projects.effort.tip: How hard your AI thinks about project work.
projects.effort.when: Lower it to spend less of your AI's limit on project help.

projects.folders.tip: More project folders of yours, by name.
projects.folders.values: A JSON object, project name → folder.
projects.folders.when: Add a project that isn't a repository Kurooto knows. `/project add` keeps its own list.

projects.help.cost: Help requests send that project's files to your AI; it works in a scratch copy, never in your folder.
projects.help.tip: The projects your AI may help with (none until you say so).
projects.help.values: A list of project names; `/project help on <name>` adds one.
projects.help.when: Add a project you want help on; remove it to stop.

proposals.inline_lines.cost: The diff travels with the message (Telegram or the app).
proposals.inline_lines.tip: A change up to this many lines is shown inside the message; a bigger one comes as a file.
proposals.inline_lines.when: Raise it to read more diffs inline.

proposals.keep_days.tip: Days an unanswered proposal is kept, with its scratch folder.
proposals.keep_days.when: Raise it if you review proposals weekly.

proposals.max_files.tip: A change touching more files than this isn't proposed.

proposals.max_kb.tip: A bigger change than this (KB) isn't proposed: ask for a smaller part.
proposals.max_kb.when: Raise it if you work on big documents.

proposals.morning.tip: When the night's proposals are told, if Dreaming is off (else in Dreaming's message).
proposals.morning.when: Move it to when you'd review them.

proposals.notes_edits.cost: Nothing leaves: the diff is shown to you.
proposals.notes_edits.tip: A change to text already in your notes comes as a proposal (Apply / Change / Discard).
proposals.notes_edits.when: Leave it on: off, the AI may change your existing note text without asking.

quests.days.tip: How many days the first-week quests run.
quests.days.when: Shorten it if you've found your way around already; `/quests stop` ends them at once.

quests.when.needs: First-week quests (they run for the first `quests.days` days).
quests.when.tip: When the day's first-week quest comes.
quests.when.when: Move it to a time you'll have a minute to try something.

quiz.by_call.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.by_call.tip: /quiz, "quiz me" and quiz check-ins ring you instead of coming as text.
quiz.by_call.when: Turn it on if you revise better out loud. Saying "here" keeps one quiz in text.

quiz.call_min.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.call_min.tip: Minutes a quiz call is meant to take.
quiz.call_min.when: Change it to fit how long you like to be quizzed.

quiz.exam_daily.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.exam_daily.tip: In exam mode, a practice check-in every day at this time; empty: never.
quiz.exam_daily.when: Set it (say, `18:00`) for a daily habit in the weeks before exams.

quiz.exam_per_session.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.exam_per_session.tip: Questions in one quiz while exam mode is on.
quiz.exam_per_session.when: Raise it if you want heavier practice close to exams.

quiz.links.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.links.tip: Recall cards from the links in your concept graph come by themselves.
quiz.links.what: A card asks how two linked concepts relate. `/card` gives one any time.
quiz.links.when: Turn it on for small daily recall between sessions.

quiz.links_at.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.links_at.tip: When a link card may come (never during a class, focus time or the night).
quiz.links_at.when: Pick times you're usually free for a minute.

quiz.links_check.cost: Nothing leaves: Local AI models only.
quiz.links_check.tip: A model on this computer says how close your answer to a link card came.
quiz.links_check.when: Turn it on if you want feedback on link cards; it never uses a cloud AI.

quiz.links_per_day.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.links_per_day.tip: The most link cards in a day (at most 5).
quiz.links_per_day.when: Lower it if they feel like too many.

quiz.offer_at.cost: Quiz questions and your answers go to your AI for grading when Chat is on; a quiz call goes through your call line and Gemini Live. Everything else stays here.
quiz.offer_at.needs: The Quiz feature (Exam season is a feature of its own).
quiz.offer_at.tip: The evening before a quiz or exam, practice is offered from this time; empty: never.

startby.window.cost: Nothing leaves this computer beyond the messages and calls themselves (Telegram, the phone app, your call line).
startby.window.tip: The hours of each day that count as free time for planning deadlines.
startby.window.values: `HH:MM-HH:MM`; an end before the start runs past midnight.
startby.window.when: Set it to the hours you actually work. A window you set is never moved by the learning.

study.break_min.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.break_min.needs: The Study tracker; Study mode on the dashboard.
study.break_min.tip: Minutes of break the Study mode timer gives after each focus session.
study.break_min.when: Set it to the break you actually take.

study.daily_note.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.daily_note.tip: When the day's study hours go into your daily note; none: never.
study.daily_note.when: Move it to just before you stop for the day.

study.focus_min.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.focus_min.needs: The Study tracker; Study mode on the dashboard.
study.focus_min.tip: Study mode's timer: minutes of focus (calls and messages wait, the time is logged).
study.focus_min.when: Set it to the length you focus well for.

study.idle_min.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.idle_min.tip: Minutes without activity before study time stops counting.
study.idle_min.when: Raise it if reading on screen without touching anything counts as away.

study.keywords.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.keywords.tip: Extra words per subject that count a window for it.
study.keywords.when: Add words that show up in your windows for a subject but aren't its name.

study.research_paths.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.research_paths.tip: Words or folders whose windows count as Research time.
study.research_paths.values: A list of words or folder names.
study.research_paths.when: Add your project folders so time there isn't lost.

study.sample_s.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.sample_s.tip: Seconds between looks at the window you're working in.
study.sample_s.when: Raise it to look less often (rounder counts); lower it for exact minutes.

study.timer_ends_mode.cost: Reading happens on this computer unless an entry says otherwise. The study tracker keeps minutes per subject only, never window titles.
study.timer_ends_mode.needs: The Study tracker; Study mode on the dashboard.
study.timer_ends_mode.tip: When a focus ends, Study mode ends too, instead of starting a break.
study.timer_ends_mode.when: Turn it on if you use one focus session at a time.

studypack.extra.cost: Nothing leaves: it goes into the zip you send yourself.
studypack.extra.tip: Your own rules for the other AI, added to the end of every study pack's prompt.
studypack.extra.values: Lines of text, one rule each.
studypack.extra.when: Add standing instructions ("use my notation", "LaTeX for maths") you'd otherwise type each time.

studypack.instructions.cost: Nothing leaves: the pack is a zip you send yourself; it never uses your AI.
studypack.instructions.tip: Your own extra lines and a format phrase ("pdf too") go into the study pack's prompt.
studypack.instructions.when: Turn it off to use the plain prompt only.

subjects.catch_up.cost: Nothing leaves: a task in Deadlines and a stub note.
subjects.catch_up.tip: A class you missed gets a catch-up task and a lecture note to fill in.
subjects.catch_up.when: Turn it off if you don't want catch-up tasks; Went to … on the message takes one back.

subjects.exam_periods.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.exam_periods.tip: Exam periods: no classes then, exams instead.
subjects.exam_periods.values: A list of `["start", "end"]` date pairs; `/term exams` fills it in.
subjects.exam_periods.when: Set them each term; Exam season and staged updates use them too.

subjects.holidays.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.holidays.when: Add holidays your timetable should skip (the term note's and a holiday calendar's count too).

subjects.list.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.list.tip: Your subjects: each one's name, short names and notes folder.
subjects.list.values: A list, typed as JSON; `/subject add` fills it in.
subjects.list.when: Use `/subject` to add or rename one; edit here only to fix a folder or short name.

subjects.margin_min.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.margin_min.tip: Minutes around a class when calls already wait (walking in, settling down).
subjects.margin_min.when: Raise it if calls catch you on the way to class.

subjects.no_calls_in_class.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.no_calls_in_class.tip: No calls while a class is on.
subjects.no_calls_in_class.when: Turn it off if calls during classes are fine (an online course, say).

subjects.term_ends.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.term_ends.tip: The last day of classes; no classes are expected after it.
subjects.term_ends.when: Set it each term (`/term ends 2026-12-04`) so calls aren't held for classes that are over.

subjects.term_note.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.term_note.tip: The note that holds your term's dates and timetable, read whenever it changes.
subjects.term_note.values: A note's path, a pattern, `auto` (find it), or empty (off).
subjects.term_note.when: Set it if your college gives a term calendar you keep as a note; its key dates join the deadline list.

subjects.timetable.cost: Nothing leaves this computer; with Chat on, the after-class answer goes to your AI to become a lecture note.
subjects.timetable.tip: Your weekly classes: subject, day, start and end.
subjects.timetable.values: A list, typed as JSON; `/class` fills it in, and so do a term note and "every Monday at 9 I have a lab".
subjects.timetable.when: Use `/class` or say it; edit here only to fix a time.

telegram.allowed_users.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
telegram.allowed_users.needs: Telegram. Not shown on the dashboard.
telegram.allowed_users.tip: The Telegram accounts that may use your bot (set when you pair).
telegram.allowed_users.values: A list of Telegram user ids.
telegram.allowed_users.when: Set by pairing. Anyone not on it is ignored, so don't add accounts you don't own.

telegram.api_base.cost: Every Telegram message goes to this address.
telegram.api_base.needs: Telegram. Not shown on the dashboard.
telegram.api_base.tip: Telegram's API address. Leave it alone.
telegram.api_base.when: Only for tests or a Bot API server of your own.

telegram.chat_id.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
telegram.chat_id.needs: Telegram. Not shown on the dashboard.
telegram.chat_id.tip: Your chat with the bot (set when you pair; don't change by hand).
telegram.chat_id.when: Never by hand: pairing sets it. Pair again (`kurooto telegram`) to move to another chat.

telegram.menu.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
telegram.menu.tip: The bot's "/" menu lists the commands of the features you have on.
telegram.menu.when: Turn it off if you'd rather keep a menu you set yourself in BotFather: Kurooto removes its own and leaves the menu alone.

telegram.silent_kinds.cost: Messages go out through Telegram's servers to your chat, or sealed through your call line to the phone app; desktop notifications stay on this computer. Calm's records (state/calm.db, 45 days) stay here.
telegram.silent_kinds.needs: Telegram and a paired phone app.
telegram.silent_kinds.tip: Kinds of message sent to Telegram without a sound.
telegram.silent_kinds.when: Add kinds you don't want buzzing your phone twice. Only while a phone app is paired (it rings by itself).

terminal.default.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.default.tip: Make Kurooto Terminal your default terminal (turning it off undoes it).
terminal.default.when: Turn it on if you'd like every new terminal in Kurooto's layout and colours.

terminal.default_opens.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.default_opens.tip: As your default terminal, what a launch opens: one shell tab, or the whole window.
terminal.default_opens.when: Pick `layout` to get every tab each time.

terminal.font_size.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.font_size.when: Raise it on a high-resolution screen.

terminal.kitty.cost: Kurooto's copy of kitty is downloaded once, if you don't have one.
terminal.kitty.tip: Linux and macOS: use kitty (yours, or Kurooto's copy); off uses your usual terminal, a window per tab.
terminal.kitty.when: Turn it off if you'd rather not install kitty.

terminal.shell.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.shell.tip: Which shell the terminal runs: fish if you have it, else yours, or one you name.
terminal.shell.values: `auto`, or a program such as `zsh` or `pwsh`.
terminal.shell.when: Name your shell if `auto` picks the wrong one.

terminal.tabs.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.tabs.tip: The Kurooto Terminal's tabs, in order: your AI's program, your shell, Kurooto chat, the log.
terminal.tabs.when: Drop tabs you don't use, or reorder them.

terminal.top.cost: Nothing leaves this computer. Fonts and colours come with Kurooto; nothing is fetched.
terminal.top.tip: Where `kurooto top` goes: a column beside the first tab, a tab of its own, or nowhere.
terminal.top.values: One of: `left` (a column beside the first tab); `tab` (a tab of its own); `off`.

turnon.offer.needs: Telegram or the phone app (where a button can be tapped).
turnon.offer.tip: When you ask for something a feature that's off would do, offer to turn it on.
turnon.offer.when: Turn it off to have such requests go straight to your AI instead.

uninstall.offer.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except downloads of the models and programs you ask it to install.
uninstall.offer.needs: Only what's on Kurooto's install receipt is ever offered: never something that was there before Kurooto.
uninstall.offer.tip: When you turn a feature off, ask whether to remove what Kurooto installed for it (a model, a program), with its size.
uninstall.offer.values: `true` (ask, Remove or Keep; nothing goes without your tap), `false` (never ask; `kurooto installed` and `kurooto remove` still work).
uninstall.offer.when: Turn it off if you switch features on and off a lot and would rather clear things up yourself.

uninstall.with_programs.cost: With it on, models you pulled through Kurooto are deleted and have to be downloaded again if you want them back.
uninstall.with_programs.tip: `kurooto uninstall` also removes the programs and models Kurooto installed for you, not only Kurooto itself.
uninstall.with_programs.values: `true` (everything on the install receipt goes too), `false` (only Kurooto, its settings and data; Ollama, Node and the rest stay).
uninstall.with_programs.when: Turn it off before uninstalling if you want to keep using Ollama, Node or the other programs on your own.

updates.channel.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.channel.tip: Stable releases, or beta for every version the day it's signed.
updates.channel.when: Pick `beta` to try new things first (and report problems); `stable` for an older, steadier version.

updates.exam_hold.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.exam_hold.needs: `updates.staged`; exam dates from Subjects and Deadlines.
updates.exam_hold.tip: Nothing installs in an exam period or within a day of a quiz or exam.
updates.exam_hold.when: Turn it off if updates during exams are fine.

updates.mode.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.mode.tip: How updates happen: by themselves at night, after asking you, or not at all.
updates.mode.values: `night` (download when found, switch in the night window), `ask` (a message with Update / Later), `off` (only a note on the dashboard).
updates.mode.when: Pick `ask` if you want to choose when; `off` only if you update by hand (`kurooto update`).

updates.staged.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.staged.tip: Wait until a release has been out a while (and not during exams) before installing it; critical ones don't wait.
updates.staged.when: Turn it on if you'd rather let others find the bugs first.

updates.wait_hours.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.wait_hours.tip: Hours a new version must have been out before it's installed.

updates.window.cost: Updates are downloaded from Kurooto's release site and checked against its signing key. Backups stay on the drive or folder you pick. Profile sync goes, encrypted, to your own private GitHub repository.
updates.window.tip: The hours an automatic update may switch versions.
updates.window.when: Move it to hours the computer is on and you're not using it.

voice.listen.after_speak_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.after_speak_s.tip: Seconds after it spoke during which a question counts as an answer to it.
voice.listen.after_speak_s.when: Raise it if you think before answering.

voice.listen.calls.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.calls.tip: Keep listening while you're on a phone call (off: listening pauses during calls).
voice.listen.calls.when: Turn it on only if your calls are on another device out of earshot.

voice.listen.close_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.close_s.tip: Seconds of nothing said to it before the spoken conversation closes.

voice.listen.conversation_follow_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.conversation_follow_s.tip: In conversation mode, a reply to what Kurooto just said counts only this soon after it.
voice.listen.conversation_follow_s.when: Lengthen it if your replies to Kurooto in a conversation get ignored.

voice.listen.conversation_mode.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.conversation_mode.needs: Voice ID (it knows which voice is yours).
voice.listen.conversation_mode.tip: While another voice is here, Kurooto stays out of people talking: only its name said to it opens a talk.
voice.listen.conversation_mode.when: Leave it on so it doesn't join your conversations with other people; nothing said then is kept.

voice.listen.conversation_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.conversation_s.tip: Seconds after the other person last spoke before Kurooto stops staying out of the conversation.
voice.listen.conversation_s.when: Lengthen it if Kurooto joins in too soon after the other person stops talking.

voice.listen.device.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.device.tip: Which microphone to use; empty is the system's default.
voice.listen.device.values: A device's name or number as your sound system lists it (the sounddevice library's names).
voice.listen.device.when: Set it if you have several microphones.

voice.listen.language.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.language.tip: The language you speak, e.g. `en` or `hi`; empty works it out each time.
voice.listen.language.when: Set it if it guesses your language wrong.

voice.listen.levels.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.levels.tip: Show the microphone's loudness as a waveform on the dashboard (numbers only).
voice.listen.levels.when: Turn it off if you don't watch the waveform.

voice.listen.model_judge.tip: When the rules can't tell whether you're talking to it, the model on this computer judges.
voice.listen.model_judge.when: Turn it off to use rules only (fewer false starts, more misses).

voice.listen.name_variants.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.name_variants.tip: More spellings of its name to accept (the common mishearings of Kurooto are built in).
voice.listen.name_variants.when: Add the way the transcriber writes the name you gave it, if it keeps missing it.

voice.listen.night.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.night.tip: Keep listening during the night hours.
voice.listen.night.when: Turn it off to stop listening at night.

voice.listen.on.cost: The speech models are downloaded once. Only turns addressed to Kurooto go to your AI.
voice.listen.on.tip: Listen through the microphone, all on this computer; only what's said to Kurooto leaves it.
voice.listen.on.when: Turn it on to talk to Kurooto out loud. It stops during calls, when paused, on battery saver and when muted.

voice.listen.stt_model.tip: How big the speech-to-text model is: tiny (75 MB), base (145 MB) or small (484 MB, more accurate).
voice.listen.stt_model.when: Pick `small` if it often mishears you and the computer is fast enough.

voice.listen.threshold.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.threshold.tip: How sure the local model must be (0 to 1) that speech is said to Kurooto.
voice.listen.threshold.when: Raise it if it answers conversations not meant for it; lower it if it ignores you.

voice.listen.wake_threshold.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.wake_threshold.tip: How sure the wake-word model must be (0 to 1).
voice.listen.wake_threshold.when: Raise it if it wakes by mistake; lower it if it misses you.

voice.listen.wake_word.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.listen.wake_word.tip: A wake-word model of your own (an openWakeWord `.onnx` path); empty: its name wakes it.
voice.listen.wake_word.when: Only if you trained your own wake word.

voice.speak.engine.cost: The voice's files are downloaded once.
voice.speak.engine.tip: The voice made on this computer: Kokoro (natural, about 0.55 GB), Piper (lighter) or off.
voice.speak.engine.when: Pick `piper` on an older computer; `kokoro` sounds more natural.

voice.speak.max_chars.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speak.max_chars.tip: How much of a long answer is read aloud before it says "the rest is on screen".
voice.speak.max_chars.when: Raise it to hear long answers in full.

voice.speak.on.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speak.on.tip: Kurooto speaks through this computer's speakers.
voice.speak.on.when: Turn it off to keep Voice for listening only, or for a silent room.

voice.speak.rate.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speak.rate.tip: How fast it speaks: 1.0 is normal, 0.8 slower, 1.2 faster.
voice.speak.rate.when: Slow it down for long answers, speed it up if you're used to it.

voice.speak.voice.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speak.voice.tip: Which Kokoro voice it speaks in; empty is `af_heart`.
voice.speak.voice.values: A Kokoro voice name: `af_heart`, `af_bella`, `am_michael`, `bf_emma`, `bm_george` and more.
voice.speak.voice.when: Try a few with `/voice say` and keep the one you like.

voice.speak.what.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speak.what.tip: What's read aloud: answers to what you said aloud, every AI answer, or nothing.
voice.speak.what.values: `voice` (answers to what you said aloud), `all` (every AI answer) or `off`.
voice.speak.what.when: Pick `all` if you work away from the screen.

voice.speaker_id.adapt.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.adapt.tip: Improve over time: turns it was very sure were you refine your voice print, slowly and with undo.
voice.speaker_id.adapt.values: `false` (default: your voice print stays as trained), `true`.
voice.speaker_id.adapt.when: Turn it on if your voice changes (a cold, a new mic) and you'd rather it keeps up by itself.

voice.speaker_id.adapt_max.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.adapt_max.tip: At most this many learned turns are kept in your voice print (the oldest are replaced).
voice.speaker_id.adapt_max.when: Lower it to keep your voice print closer to the samples you trained with.

voice.speaker_id.adapt_per_day.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.adapt_per_day.tip: A daily cap on how many of your turns may be added to your voice print.
voice.speaker_id.adapt_per_day.when: Lower it to make the voice print change more slowly.

voice.speaker_id.carry.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.carry.tip: A short reply right after a turn it knew was you counts as you (not when the voice is clearly someone else).
voice.speaker_id.carry.when: Turn it off (or use strict) if guests could answer 'yes' for you.

voice.speaker_id.carry_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.carry_s.tip: The window, in seconds, in which a quick reply after you spoke still counts as you.
voice.speaker_id.carry_s.when: Shorten it in a shared room; lengthen it if your quick follow-ups get refused.

voice.speaker_id.gate.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.gate.tip: Check who's speaking before writing words out: other people not calling Kurooto are never transcribed.
voice.speaker_id.gate.values: `true` (others' talk is dropped before transcription), `false` (everything is transcribed, then sorted as in 0.8.8).
voice.speaker_id.gate.when: Leave it on: it keeps other people's conversations private and saves the transcription's processor time.

voice.speaker_id.guest_brain.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.guest_brain.needs: For `local`, Local AI models with a chat model.
voice.speaker_id.guest_brain.tip: Who answers other voices: your AI (none of your data, no tools) or the model on this computer.
voice.speaker_id.guest_brain.values: `main` (your AI, only if it can be held to plain text: an API or Claude Code; with agy or Codex the local model answers), `local` (always this computer).
voice.speaker_id.guest_brain.when: Pick `local` to keep guests' words on this computer.

voice.speaker_id.guest_per_hour.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.guest_per_hour.tip: At most this many answers to other voices an hour.
voice.speaker_id.guest_per_hour.when: Lower it if guests use up your AI's quota.

voice.speaker_id.margin.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.margin.tip: The 'not sure' band just below the threshold, at most 0.2 wide. Not sure always counts as not you.
voice.speaker_id.margin.when: Widen it to be safer; narrow it if you're asked to repeat yourself too often.

voice.speaker_id.min_speech_s.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.min_speech_s.tip: Speech shorter than this is too short to tell who it is, so it counts as not sure.
voice.speaker_id.min_speech_s.when: Raise it if quick one-word sounds get mistaken; lower it if your short answers are often 'not sure'.

voice.speaker_id.mode.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.mode.tip: What other voices get: a chat with no actions and none of your data, or just one line saying it only talks with you.
voice.speaker_id.mode.values: `owner_only_acts` (others may chat), `owner_only_at_all` (others hear one line, nothing more).
voice.speaker_id.mode.when: Pick `owner_only_at_all` if you don't want Kurooto chatting with anyone else at all.

voice.speaker_id.model.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.model.tip: The speaker model: campplus-en (English, the most accurate) or campplus-multi. Changing it means enrolling again.
voice.speaker_id.model.when: Pick campplus-multi if you speak to Kurooto mostly in another language.

voice.speaker_id.on.cost: About 20-60 ms of processor per thing said. Your voice print is stored encrypted on this computer, never sent anywhere.
voice.speaker_id.on.needs: Voice: talk and listen, and an enrolled voice.
voice.speaker_id.on.tip: Voice ID: only your voice can make Kurooto act; others can only chat, with none of your data. Enrol first.
voice.speaker_id.on.values: `true` (each turn is checked against your voice print, on this computer), `false` (any voice is treated as yours, as before).
voice.speaker_id.on.when: Turn it on if other people are ever near the computer while Voice listens. Enrol on the Your voice page first.

voice.speaker_id.spoken_enrol.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.spoken_enrol.tip: During enrolment Kurooto says each step aloud. Off: the page shows the steps only.
voice.speaker_id.spoken_enrol.when: Turn it off if you enrol somewhere you can't have it talk aloud.

voice.speaker_id.strictness.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.strictness.tip: How sure it must be that it's you: relaxed, normal or strict (strict turns you away more often).
voice.speaker_id.strictness.when: Strict if a lot of people are around; relaxed if it keeps asking you again in a noisy room.

voice.speaker_id.tell_guests.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.tell_guests.tip: Once per conversation, tell others they can chat but only you can make Kurooto act.
voice.speaker_id.tell_guests.when: Turn it off if you'd rather it just chats without saying so.

voice.speaker_id.threshold.cost: Sound is handled on this computer and never touches the disk. Only turns said to Kurooto go to your AI, as a chat message would.
voice.speaker_id.threshold.tip: 0: worked out from your own samples when you train. A number overrides it, held to 0.30 to 0.95.
voice.speaker_id.threshold.when: Leave it at 0 unless the Test step on the Your voice page shows it gets it wrong.

voice_notes.api_base.cost: Voice notes go to that address.
voice_notes.api_base.tip: Another address for the voice-note model; empty is Google's.
voice_notes.api_base.when: Only for a proxy or a compatible server of your own.

voice_notes.model.cost: Each voice note's audio goes to Google with your Gemini key.
voice_notes.model.needs: Voice notes, and a Gemini key.
voice_notes.model.tip: Which Gemini model writes out your voice notes.
voice_notes.model.when: Change it when a better or cheaper speech model is out.

web.port.cost: Nothing leaves this computer, except downloads of the models and programs you ask it to install.
web.port.tip: The dashboard's port on this computer (read when Kurooto starts).
web.port.when: Change it only if another program uses 8770. Restart Kurooto afterwards; bookmarks need the new port.

weekly.call.cost: A call (call line and Gemini Live); with Chat on, its write-up goes through your AI.
weekly.call.needs: The Weekly summary and Phone calls.
weekly.call.tip: A Sunday review call after the summary: the week, what went well, next week's priorities.
weekly.call.when: Turn it on if you'd like to talk the week through.

weekly.people.tip: One line about the people in your project notes: who you met this week and who's next.
weekly.people.when: Turn it off if you don't want people in the summary. Only from meetings logged in your project notes.

weekly.when.cost: Nothing leaves: counted from the local event log.
weekly.when.when: Move it to when you plan your week.

you.assistant_name.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
you.assistant_name.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
you.assistant_name.tip: The name your assistant goes by in messages, calls and the dashboard.
you.assistant_name.when: When you'd rather call it something else. Your Telegram bot takes the new name at once and says so; messages, calls and the AI use it from the next one.

you.language.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
you.language.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
you.language.tip: Which language answers come in: the one you wrote in, or always one you name.
you.language.values: `follow` (the language of your message), or a language's name such as `English` or `Hindi`.
you.language.when: When you write in a mix and want answers always in one language. Only the wording of AI answers changes; Kurooto's own fixed messages stay in English.

you.name.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
you.name.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
you.name.tip: Your name, as Kurooto uses it in messages and calls.
you.name.when: Set it at setup or when it gets your name wrong. Messages, the morning page and calls use it from the next one; empty, Kurooto just doesn't use a name.

you.timezone.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
you.timezone.needs: Nothing: these are core settings, always there.
you.timezone.tip: Your time zone, for every time Kurooto keeps; empty follows this computer's clock.
you.timezone.values: An IANA zone name such as `Asia/Kolkata` or `Europe/Berlin`, or empty.
you.timezone.what: Reminders, check-ins, the alarm, night hours and every schedule are worked out in this zone.
you.timezone.when: When this computer's clock is set to another zone than the one you live in (a server, a travel laptop). The schedule reads it when Kurooto starts, so restart it after a change; times already set keep their wall-clock time in the new zone.

you.workspace.cost: Nothing by itself. The persona card's lines travel with each request to the AI you chose, like the rest of the request.
you.workspace.needs: Read when Kurooto starts: restart after changing it. Notes sync, the notes brain and the sorter all work in this folder.
you.workspace.tip: Your notes folder: where Kurooto reads and writes notes, journal and course files.
you.workspace.values: A full folder path, or empty for `Documents/Kurooto`.
you.workspace.what: Everything Kurooto writes (journal, course notes, book notes, its own blocks) goes inside it. Obsidian works on it as it is.
you.workspace.when: Set it at setup to the folder you already keep notes in. Changing it later points Kurooto at the new folder from its next start; nothing is moved, so move your notes yourself first.
